summary: Retested the forgot-password fix and ran regressions on Expo web at 375x667. Forgot-password now works: password step -> login-forgot-password -> code step (/auth/otp/request and /auth/otp/verify were MOCKED in Playwright, no real SMS was sent) -> set-password-step appears and stays on /login. It no longer jumps to /dist. This works both with and without the device-conflict sheet (reset is kept through confirmConflict with force=true). The POST /auth/password request is sent with 'Bearer <session_token>' and the body {password}. The real server answers 400 ('لتغيير كلمة المرور سجّل الدخول برمز SMS عبر "نسيت كلمة المرور"'), which is expected because the mocked token has no pw_reset_until. The error is shown in login-error. With a mocked 200 save, the app goes to /dist. Regressions pass: agent +963900000004/Agent12345 reaches /dist and owner +963900000002/Owner12345 reaches /owner (device-conflict sheet shown, 'نعم' accepted). Seed check: org_test_1 was PATCHed to SUSPENDED, then seedTestAccounts set it back to ACTIVE. Test users are not blocked.

integration_issues.issue: The reset flag lives only in client state: has_password:false is set locally after the verify. If the app is reloaded or killed on set-password-step, boot /auth/me returns has_password:true and the user goes straight home without setting a new password. The 15-min server reset window is still open, but the UI gives no way back to it. Low priority. Optional fix: have /auth/me return a pw_reset_pending flag while pw_reset_until > now.

issues: The title says 'أنشئ كلمة مرور لحسابك' (create a password) even during a reset. 'تعيين كلمة مرور جديدة' would read better. Copy only, minor.

action_items: Optional: persist the reset-pending state on the server (e.g. a flag on /auth/me) so that a reload during the reset still shows set-password-step.
Optional: change the set-password title when in reset mode.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx signIn(): the reset override (has_password:false) is applied before the user is cached, and the conflict payload carries reset, so confirmConflict keeps the reset. Correct.
setPassword() sets has_password:true only on success. A server refusal keeps the user on set-password-step with an error, and the logout button is available. Good.
edge.ts seedTestAccounts now patches the existing org_test_1 to ACTIVE and sets expires_at to +365d. Verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (forgot-password with and without conflict, agent login, owner login, seed reset)

seed_data_creation: Set org_test_1 to SUSPENDED temporarily to check the seed reset, then re-seeded. Re-seeded again at the end; all 4 test tokens return 200. Passwords are unchanged (Agent12345 / Owner12345).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mock /api/auth/otp/request and /api/auth/otp/verify with page.route (verify returns {session_token:'test_token_agent', user:<from /auth/me>}). The device-conflict 'yes' button animates in: wait about 1.5s, or use dispatch_event('click'). Real password logins show the device-conflict sheet and revoke the seeded tokens, so re-seed afterwards.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 bug is fixed: the reset intent is now stored in AuthProvider user state (has_password:false), so homeFor() returns 'login' and the gate no longer unmounts the set-password step.
